title: How to prepare a successful proposal in Horizon Europe
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: A full-day Commission webinar on proposal submission and evaluation and on the rules of the Model Grant Agreement.
covers: Submission and evaluation of proposals: the template, basic principles and evaluation criteria
The rules of the game: the Model Grant Agreement
materials: Agenda, presentation slides (the submission slides were later updated), the standard application form for Research and Innovation and Innovation Actions, the General Model Grant Agreement and the GEAR tool on gender equality
why: Kept as a reference library: the application form and Model Grant Agreement linked from the page are the documents applicants work with. For a current overview, start with the March 2025 implementation day on submitting a proposal.
